summary: Among Us entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Among Us

emulation.notes: Use the current native or official release route where available.

primary.why: The PC release gives the cleanest capture and input route for the shared Among Us live game, while official console/mobile store pages cover the later platform ports.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows version on Steam or another official PC storefront. Capture the game version/date and avoid treating Among Us 3D/VR as the same entry.

all_releases.fidelity: Original mobile release family, still useful for touch/mobile context.
all_releases.reason: skip: same core game content, lower capture/input suitability than PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Native PC build with straightforward capture and keyboard/mouse/chat workflow.
all_releases.reason: primary: best archive route for the standard 2D game.

all_releases.fidelity: Official console port with online/local play support.
all_releases.reason: skip: no sourced gameplay-exclusive content requiring a secondary route.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation 4 / PlayStation 5 / Xbox One / Xbox Series
all_releases.fidelity: Official console ports with crossplay support listed on platform stores.
all_releases.reason: skip: same core game, no sourced story/mission/mode exclusives needed for archive completion.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced story/mission/mode exclusive on another platform requires a secondary route; platform cosmetics are not enough for Sami's secondary-play rule.

entries.remaster_caveats: Among Us 3D/VR and Among Us Story are separate games/branches, not replacement releases for the standard 2D Among Us entry.
